title: Upwork one-shot
does: Answers a freelance job post with a short letter, a working demo and a short video. For people who sell services that can be shown working.

fazio.when: the user says run it like Fazio: his public method; course lessons only from the user's own private copy

hormozi.when: offer design is the weak point: value, guarantee, pricing, lead channels

max.when: cold outbound and video structure, as in Max Forbang's ocp.wiki

stages.task: Write the one offer this business makes in a proposal: outcome, what they get, proof actually found in the profile.
Write the search queries to save and the rules for which job posts to answer or skip.
Plan the demo for this job post: problem in their words, screens, sample data from the post.
Write the video script for this job post.
Write the proposal letter for this job post.

quotes.text: reply to a fresh, fit job post within the first hour with a package no other bidder sends
Every claim in the video and letter traces to the post or to a built artifact.
Attach the MP4 as a file; never a link before a contract.
Value = (Dream Outcome × Perceived Likelihood of Achievement) ÷ (Time Delay × Effort & Sacrifice)
A message that would still make sense sent to someone else is not personal enough.
A cold buyer is offered one specific result with the risk moved off them.
